chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام said:
"When you comb your beard and your head, then pass the comb over your chest, for it takes away worry and lethargy."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kadhim عليه السلام teach about combing the beard and head?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys an etiquette of personal grooming taught by Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام. It links cleanliness and bodily care with emotional ease, stating that passing the comb over the chest helps remove worry and lethargy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.320 - Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
"When you comb your beard and head, pass the comb over your chest as well, for it removes worry and lethargy”.
